name: At what stage of a home remodel should tile work take place?

mainEntity.name: At what stage of a home remodel should tile work take place?

acceptedAnswer.text: During a full kitchen or bathroom remodel, tile installation happens after rough plumbing, electrical work, and drywall hanging are complete, but usually before finish plumbing trim and final paint touch-ups. In bathrooms, shower pans and wall backer boards are installed and fully waterproofed before tile work begins, with vanities placed either before or after floor tile depending on design choices. In kitchens, flooring is set before cabinets or tight to their bases, while backsplash tile goes in strictly after countertops are secured. An on-site general contractor coordinates these trade sequences to avoid trades working over newly laid surfaces.
acceptedAnswer.description: Tile is installed after rough-in plumbing, wiring, and drywall, but before vanity trim, plumbing fixtures, and final paint finish coats.
